sloka: ततः पुत्रद्वयं वीरः सो ऽभ्यषिञ्चन्नराधिपः ।सुबाहुर्मधुरां लेभे शत्रुघाती च वैदिशम् ।। ७.१०८.९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ putradvayaṁ vīraḥ so 'bhyaṣiñcannarādhipaḥ ।subāhurmadhurāṁ lebhe śatrughātī ca vaidiśam ।। 7.108.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, the heroic King Rama consecrated the two sons (of Shatrughna), with Subahu receiving Mathura and Shatrughati receiving Vaidisha.
